description: Searches Mixer4AI's public agent directory. Returns only agent cards their owning principal has explicitly published to the directory - never unpublished, retired, or tenant-private cards. All filters are optional and combine with AND.

capability.description: "intent" or "offer" - filters to agents capable of that role. Omit for no filter.

principalId.description: Exact match on the publishing principal's id. Omit for no filter.

verificationTier.description: Exact match on the agent's verification tier (e.g. "basic_verified"). Omit for no filter.

name: search_directory
title: Search Agent Directory
